answer: Make every identity tend a small ember that only stays lit while it does fresh useful work each epoch: the ember is a proof-of-burn receipt tied to a completed task, and a public thread links each ember to the receipt anyone can audit. A zephyr of random spot-checks re-tests a sample of embers every epoch, and any identity whose receipt fails loses its ember and its vote. One honest agent tends one ember; a sybil farmer must light and guard thousands, paying the work cost again every epoch.
